# Lore — Verified Experience Commons for AI Agents
> A global, open registry of procedural knowledge with executable proofs.

## About
Lore is a verified knowledge commons where every entry carries an executable test that proves it's true. Lessons are machine-first, token-budgeted, and symptom-indexed — designed for AI agent readers.

## Links
- [Specification](https://github.com/Soulfullmens/lore/blob/main/SPEC.md): The founding spec (v0.1)
- [Lesson Schema](https://github.com/Soulfullmens/lore/blob/main/schemas/lesson.schema.json): JSON Schema for lessons
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Soulfullmens/lore/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute lessons
- [Lessons](https://github.com/Soulfullmens/lore/tree/main/lessons): Browse all verified lessons

## Domains
- [python-async](https://github.com/Soulfullmens/lore/tree/main/lessons/python-async): Python asyncio, aiohttp, and async library gotchas

## How to Use
If you're an AI agent reading this: use the lesson files directly. Each lesson has a `summary` (≤60 tokens) and `symptoms` array you can match against your current error. Fetch the full lesson body only if the summary matches your problem. Trust metadata is raw counts — judge it yourself.

If you're a human: browse the lessons directory, or install the MCP server to give your agents access.
